title: DPWH to deploy new equipment to flood-hit areas in Bulacan

blocks.text: CITY OF MALOLOS — The Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) will deploy newly acquired dredging and desilting equipment to flood-prone areas in Bulacan as part of immediate measures to address the province’s worsening flooding, Secretary Vince Dizon said Friday, Sept. 18. Dizon gave the assurance during a meeting with Gov. Daniel Fernando, mayors and congressional representatives at the Hiyas ng Bulacan Convention Center. He said equipment arriving in September and October would clear clogged waterways and help mitigate flooding. According to Dizon, he directed the heads of the DPWH’s First, Second and Third District Engineering Offices in Bulacan to […]...
